measure_rows.measured_space_or_domain: Archive-file, manifest, registry, and package metadata domain; not a physical measure over candidate states, histories, vacua, observers, or public records.
measure_rows.sigma_algebra_or_counting_rule: Counts files, rows, manifests, and provenance wrappers only. It does not define physical events, path-integral histories, ensemble members, or observer reference classes.
measure_rows.normalization_or_cutoff_rule: Package completeness and lint coverage can be counted, but those counts are custody/audit counts and never physical probability normalization.
measure_rows.gauge_or_duplicate_quotient: Duplicate file or row identifiers may be audited; physical duplicate-state, gauge-copy, vacuum, or observer-copy quotients remain outside this metadata wrapper.
measure_rows.measure_problem_or_infinite_count_risk: Failure appears when archive size, generated summaries, citation counts, or metadata completeness are mistaken for physical measure support.
measure_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer probability, typicality, naturalness, path-integral definition, ensemble support, or candidate promotion from metadata/provenance counts.
measure_rows.authority_spend_rule: For multi-route rows, this row-level S-field is a family-level envelope only; route-spendable credit is limited by route_authority_ceilings and the route state ledger.
